regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Sugar Bowl is forecast for about 55", 28" of it Wednesday. Palisades and Kirkwood follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Sugar Bowl Tuesday night and Wednesday. Winter Storm Warning at Sugar Bowl from Tuesday night to Friday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 33". The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Wednesday and Wednesday night. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 47 to 70 inches Tuesday night through Thursday night. Winter Storm Warning at Mammoth from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Powder Mountain is forecast for about 22". Snowbasin and Alta follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Snowbasin Tuesday. The NWS is calling for more at Powder Mountain: 25 to 48 inches Tuesday through Friday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Powder Mountain from Tuesday to Wednesday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 16", 9" of it Tuesday. Jackson Hole and Sun Valley follow. The NWS is calling for more at Grand Targhee: 15 to 31 inches Tuesday through Saturday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Grand Targhee from Tuesday to Wednesday.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 7", 4" of it Tuesday. Taos follows. The NWS is calling for more at Wolf Creek: 12 to 26 inches Tuesday through Friday.
